name: set
description: Store (or replace) a secret, sealed with the OS keystore (NexusSecretCrypt, the provider api keys' at-rest encryption) in the profile's `nexus.secrets` pref. The name is namespaced — `provider:…`, `plugin:…` or `mcp:…`, the rest 1-128 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_.:/@-] — and the secret is bound to ONE origin: it is substituted (`{{secret:NAME}}` in network.httpRequest / network.streamOpen header and query values) only into a request whose URL has exactly that origin. With processEnv (plugin: and mcp: names only) shell.spawn may also lay it into a child's env (`{{secret:NAME}}` in an env value; a secret without the mark is SECRET_NOT_PERMITTED there), and origin may then be omitted for a process-only secret no network request can use — advertised as shell.spawn.secretEnv (an older host refuses the missing origin and ignores processEnv). There is no get: the plaintext never comes back to the guest. Refuses with SECRET_STORE_UNAVAILABLE rather than store plaintext when the keystore is not ready; TOO_MANY_SECRETS past 512. Returns { ok: true }. Additive capability: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED (and does not advertise `secrets`).

inputs.name: origin
inputs.description: The origin the secret is bound to: an https URL (http only for localhost); path, query and fragment are ignored. Required unless processEnv is true.

inputs.name: processEnv
inputs.description: Also allow shell.spawn to substitute it into a child's env values. plugin: and mcp: names only (INVALID_ARGS otherwise). Default false; replacing a secret without it clears the mark.
